title: Unit Event — Backlight, Lens Flare — Episode7 The Final Day

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's next step is to appear as extras in a film! Each of them is enthusiastic about this opportunity to work their magic on camera, and Rui is particularly eager to learn about a different type of directing. However, not everything goes smoothly...

rows.Line: The next day
Beach

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
That's all for this morning!
We'll resume shooting after lunch!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our morning shoot's already over...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After lunch, we'll be doing that scene again.)
I'd try to rethink this scene with Reki Bakuno in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (With those words in mind, I rewatched all the old footage I could.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Not just for this film...
I even asked Mr. Kato to send over footage of any of Bakuno's previous stage performances.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Unfortunately...
I still wasn't able to find an answer.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(What are we missing?
What did he see...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Rui, is something wrong?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Rin...?
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You haven't really slept since yesterday, so I came to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wait, those bags under your eyes!
You really should get some rest if you can!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You got me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I'm okay.
More importantly, I need to figure out what we're missing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There you are, Rui!
Oh, Rin's here as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Huh?
What's with the big bag, Tsukasa?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
It's full of our lunches, including yours, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, including me...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're heading over to the airport to shoot that scene again after lunch, right? So, we think you should eat while you can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Having some yummy food should help you come up with really good ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why we brought you a hearty barbeque lunch! This was the last one they had, so you should consider yourself lucky!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that I should provide myself with some nourishment. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, you guys' lunches are all different!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nene's got a Japanese-style lunch, Emu's looks Western, and Tsukasa's having some sandwiches!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so great how we get to choose our lunches like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good point. Normally, you would expect them to provide the same meal for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But considering how many people are working on this film, there must be a wide range of preferences, and they've given us a few choices to meet everyone's needs!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To meet everyone's needs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I just thought of something amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Getting to choose our lunches is really nice!
But wouldn't it be even nicer if we could choose what's inside?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Take Rui's lunch for example. It's a big barbeque lunch that's chock-full of meat and vegetables, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But Rui hates vegetables.
So, wouldn't it make him happier if he were allowed to have no veggies?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As for me, I'd want to have lots and lots more veggies instead of meat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It wouldn't be much of a “barbeque” lunch if you did that. Also, you're basically talking about a buffet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Individualized lunches based on each person's wants and needs...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now I see...
That's what we've been missing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you figure something out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I think I understand why that scene didn't go as well as planned.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I need to go talk to Mr. Ohara.
The rest of you keep eating.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, wait a—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
There he goes...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: ...is how I'd like you to do this scene now.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Pardon the interruption, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
You look like you're out of breath.
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, it's about that one scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think I know what you need to do in order for it to go the way you want.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
What...?!
You also had an idea?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Also?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Yes, I was just discussing my new plan for it with Bakuno.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: It hit me last night. My friend said he'd rethink the scene to fit Reki Bakuno better, but I thought I'd been doing that up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: But further editing what we had didn't give me the answer. Which meant that the problem didn't lie there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The problem was the screenplay...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Looks like we landed on the same answer.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: This screenplay is based on the original novel. As such, the lines for each character are more or less all taken straight from it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. In particular, the climax scene is completely faithful to the dialogue in the book.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Exactly. Unfortunately, that dialogue is intended to have maximum impact when read as a part of a novel.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
In other words...
It won't necessarily translate well over to film.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but... These lines aren't bad or anything. This scene still works with them in place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may not have run into any problems if we were working with a different cast. However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because Bakuno is playing Katsuyuki, there has to be a better way to do this scene.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, as important as it is to stay faithful to the original story, the lines for this scene need to suit Bakuno's style better.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They need to be rewritten in order to allow him to put his skills to full use.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Haha. I see...
Even you decided to stop there.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Mr. Ohara?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
That won't be enough, Kamishiro.
I'm thinking about going even further.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Credit where credit's due, you did better than most would in your situation. I commend you for that.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: But I'd be out of a job if a filmmaking novice like you managed to come up with the same answer as me.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: U-Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: It's time to show all you youngsters.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: You're going to see what Tomomi Ohara is really capable of.
